title: Answer: information is intrinsic, the cause-effect power a system specifies over itself

statements.text: Integrated information theory separates two senses of information. Shannon information measures a message as a reduction of uncertainty, seen from outside by an observer or a communication engineer. Intrinsic information is the cause-effect power a system in its state specifies over itself, from its own perspective. Integrated information is meaning: a cause-effect structure unfolded from a substrate, which is an experience and its contents, rather than a message or a code.
statements.scope: IIT 4.0 (2022) and the paper Shannon information and integrated information (2024)

sources.quote: Information theory quantifies the information content of the message as reduction of uncertainty from the extrinsic perspective of a communication engineer.

sources.locator: section on existence, intrinsicality and information, p. 12
sources.quote: we quantify the cause–effect power of a system from its intrinsic perspective, rather than from the perspective of an outside observer
IIT considers meaning as integrated information and characterizes it as a structure, rather than as a message or code.
